mergedParams.userDescription: Projector slide carousel click change flash transition effects between videos

output.title: Projector Carousel Click & Flash Video Transitions

prompts.prompt: Create a projector slide carousel transition preset that mimics vintage slide projector mechanics. The transition should feature a bright white flash effect that occurs during the media changeover, similar to the burst of light when a physical slide projector advances to the next slide. Structure this with a single BaseLayout container containing two VideoAtom elements. During the 0.3 second overlap period, apply a dramatic white flash overlay using a ShapeAtom that quickly fades in and out (0.1s in, 0.1s hold, 0.1s out). The outgoing video should cut to black abruptly at the transition point while the incoming video fades in from the white flash. Add subtle mechanical shake effects during the transition to simulate the physical movement of slides changing. Include a clicking sound effect using AudioAtom timed precisely with the flash moment.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout duration = video1.duration + video2.duration - 0.3s overlap. Use absolute positioning with 'absolute inset-0' for all atoms. ShapeAtom with white background at z-20 for flash effect. VideoAtom positioning with z-10 for outgoing, z-15 for incoming. Generic opacity effect on ShapeAtom: [{from: 0, to: 0.1, value: [0, 1]}, {from: 0.1, to: 0.2, value: 1}, {from: 0.2, to: 0.3, value: [1, 0]}]. Transform shake effect on BaseLayout: small translateX/Y movements during overlap. AudioAtom with click.mp3 starting at transition point.

prompts.prompt: Design a horizontal slide carousel transition that emulates a mechanical film strip advancing through a projector gate. The transition should create the illusion of videos sliding horizontally like frames on a film reel, with a brief moment of motion blur and light leak between frames. Use a BaseLayout container with two VideoAtom elements positioned side by side. During a 0.5 second overlap, the outgoing video slides left with easing while the incoming video slides in from the right. Add a semi-transparent vertical light streak effect using a gradient ShapeAtom that sweeps across during the transition, simulating the projector light bleeding between frames. Include subtle vignetting that intensifies during the transition.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative overflow-hidden' for masking. Outgoing VideoAtom starts at 'absolute inset-0', transforms to translateX(-100%) during overlap. Incoming VideoAtom starts at 'absolute inset-0 translate-x-full', transforms to translateX(0). Light streak ShapeAtom with linear gradient (transparent to white to transparent) animated with translateX from -100% to 200%. Generic transform effects using provider mode with targetIds. Vignette effect using filter brightness/contrast adjustments. Timing: 0.5s overlap with ease-out curve.

prompts.prompt: Build a rotating carousel cube transition where videos appear to be mounted on the faces of a 3D cube that rotates to reveal the next video. This should feel like a physical slide carousel drum rotating to the next position. Create perspective depth using CSS 3D transforms within a BaseLayout container. Position VideoAtom elements with 3D transforms to create cube faces. During the 0.8 second transition, rotate the entire container 90 degrees on the Y-axis while maintaining perspective. Add a bright flash effect at the midpoint of rotation when faces are perpendicular to the viewer, simulating the projector light hitting the edge of the slide.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'preserve-3d' transform-style and perspective (1000px). VideoAtom positioning: outgoing at rotateY(0deg) translateZ(50vw), incoming at rotateY(90deg) translateZ(50vw). Generic transform effect on container: rotateY animation from 0 to -90deg over 0.8s with ease-in-out. Flash overlay using ShapeAtom with opacity spike at 0.4s mark. Z-index management for proper layering during rotation. BackfaceVisibility hidden on VideoAtoms.

prompts.prompt: Develop a stroboscopic flash transition that simulates multiple rapid projector flashes as slides advance quickly through a carousel. The effect should create a stuttering, stop-motion feel with multiple white flashes occurring in rapid succession. Structure with a BaseLayout containing VideoAtom elements and multiple ShapeAtom flash overlays. During the 0.6 second transition, trigger 3-4 quick white flashes (each 0.05s duration) while gradually transitioning from the outgoing to incoming video. Between flashes, show brief glimpses of both videos with varying opacity levels to create a double-exposure effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with multiple ShapeAtom overlays for flash sequences. Flash timing: [0-0.05s, 0.15-0.2s, 0.35-0.4s, 0.55-0.6s]. VideoAtom opacity curves: outgoing fades from 1 to 0 in steps synchronized with flashes, incoming fades from 0 to 1 in opposite steps. Generic opacity effects with complex AnimationRange arrays for stuttered transitions. White ShapeAtoms at z-30 with sharp opacity spikes. Double exposure achieved by overlapping semi-transparent videos between flashes.

prompts.prompt: Create a film burn transition that simulates the effect of a slide getting stuck in a hot projector and burning away to reveal the next image. Start with normal video playback, then during transition, apply increasing heat distortion, color shifts to orange/white, and finally have the outgoing video appear to burn away in an organic pattern while the incoming video is revealed underneath. Use filter effects for color manipulation and mask animations for the burn-away effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with two VideoAtoms layered. Outgoing video with animated filter effects: hue-rotate (0 to 30deg), brightness (1 to 2), contrast (1 to 1.5) over first 0.3s of 0.7s transition. Mask effect using clip-path or mask-image with radial gradient animation to create organic burn pattern. Incoming video static at z-0, revealed as outgoing burns away. Optional smoke/heat shimmer effect using blur filter with varying intensity. Transform scale slight warping during peak burn.

prompts.prompt: Design a mechanical iris transition that mimics vintage projector aperture mechanisms. The transition should feature a circular iris that closes on the outgoing video while simultaneously opening on the incoming video, with a bright flash occurring when the iris is fully closed. Create smooth mechanical movement with precise timing. Use clip-path animations to achieve the iris effect, ensuring the closing and opening movements feel connected and mechanical.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with two VideoAtoms using circular clip-path animations. Outgoing: clip-path circle from 100% to 0% radius over 0.4s ease-in. Incoming: clip-path circle from 0% to 100% radius over 0.4s ease-out, starting at 0.3s. Total overlap: 0.5s. Flash ShapeAtom at z-40 with 0.1s white flash at 0.4s mark (iris fully closed). Center point of circles at 50% 50%. Optional mechanical sound effect timed with iris movement.

prompts.prompt: Build a split-flap display transition inspired by mechanical departure boards and slide carousels. Videos should appear to flip in segments like split-flap displays, with each segment rotating independently but in sequence. Divide the screen into horizontal strips (6-8 segments) and animate each strip's rotation with a slight time offset. Include clicking sounds and brief shadows during flips to enhance the mechanical feeling.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with multiple masked regions using absolute positioned divs. Each strip is a container with two VideoAtom clones (outgoing/incoming) masked to show only that horizontal segment. Transform rotateX animations staggered by 0.05s per strip. Each strip: 0.3s rotation duration, perspective(800px) on containers. Shadow effects using box-shadow during rotation. Click AudioAtom triggered for each strip flip. Total transition: 0.8s including stagger delays.

prompts.prompt: Create a projector malfunction glitch transition where the slide carousel appears to jam and skip frames rapidly. The transition should feel chaotic but controlled, with quick flashes between multiple 'slides' (video frames), horizontal scan lines, color channel splits, and mechanical stuttering. Include brief moments where both videos are visible simultaneously with different blend modes, simulating slides overlapping in the gate.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with rapid opacity and transform changes. Multiple quick cuts between videos: 5-6 rapid switches over 0.6s. RGB channel split using multiple VideoAtoms with red/green/blue filter effects offset by a few pixels. Scan line effect using repeating linear gradient overlay. Transform jitter: small random translateX/Y values changing every 0.05s. Blend modes alternating between screen, multiply, and overlay during glitch moments. Sharp clicking/mechanical sounds synced with visual glitches.

prompts.prompt: Design a depth-of-field rack focus transition that simulates a projector lens focusing between two slides at different focal distances. Start with the outgoing video in sharp focus, gradually blur it while simultaneously bringing the incoming video from extreme blur into sharp focus. The transition should feel like a camera pulling focus between two physical slides at different depths. Add subtle chromatic aberration at peak blur to simulate lens imperfections.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with two VideoAtoms at different simulated depths using scale. Outgoing: scale(1) to scale(1.1) with blur(0) to blur(20px) over 0.7s. Incoming: scale(0.9) to scale(1) with blur(20px) to blur(0) over same period. Chromatic aberration using separate RGB channels with slight position offsets at peak blur. Filter effects using generic animation with complex curves. Optional: slight brightness changes to simulate depth-of-field light falloff. Z-index: incoming behind outgoing initially, switch at midpoint.

prompts.prompt: Develop a vintage kaleidoscope transition inspired by old projection equipment with rotating color wheels and prisms. The outgoing video should fragment into triangular pieces that rotate and multiply like a kaleidoscope pattern, gradually morphing into the incoming video through the same prismatic effect. Include rainbow light refractions at the edges of fragments and a mechanical rotation feeling throughout.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with CSS mask patterns creating triangular segments. Multiple VideoAtom clones with different rotation origins and clip-paths to create kaleidoscope effect. Transform rotate animations on each segment with varying speeds (30deg to 360deg). Incoming video uses inverse kaleidoscope assembly starting fragmented and resolving to normal. Rainbow refraction using CSS gradients on segment edges. Mix-blend-mode: screen for light leak effects. 1s total transition with smooth easing. Optional: subtle hue-rotate animation for color wheel effect.
